en: There are many AI briefing systems, but this one helps you see things a little more objectively. Its weekly review brings together voices from across the political spectrum—left, right and beyond—regardless of nationality. Where possible, it also identifies their funding sources, helping you better understand whose interests they speak for.
zh: ai简报系统很多，但这个会让你更客观一点，每周周评包含各个立场无论左翼右翼还是什么国籍，顺便尽量标出他们的资金来源，才能更好地知道他们为谁在讲话。
